definitions.gloss: set phrase; template text; boilerplate; stock phrase
definitions.explanation: A fixed, standardized piece of text used repeatedly in similar situations. Composed of 定型 (fixed form) + 文 (text/sentence). Common in business emails, official documents, and digital communication.

examples.japanese: {定型文|ていけいぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{返信|へんしん}→返信：14350_henshin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{定型文|ていけいぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えて→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{便利|べんり}→便利：00830_benri⟧だ。
examples.english: It's useful to learn the standard phrases for business emails.

examples.japanese: {定型文|ていけいぶん}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{気持|きも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わらない→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Greetings that are nothing but stock phrases sometimes fail to convey genuine feelings.

notes:
USAGE:
{定型文|ていけいぶん} is widely used in business and digital communication. Many email apps and messaging platforms have a {定型文|ていけいぶん} feature that lets users save and reuse common phrases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定型文|ていけいぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}する→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧ (register a template phrase)
- {定型文|ていけいぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挿入|そうにゅう}→挿入：12828_sounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (insert a template)
- ⟦ビジネス→ビジネス：11162_bijinesu⟧{定型文|ていけいぶん} (business boilerplate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦テンプレート→テンプレート：11493_tenpureeto⟧ is the loanword for "template" and is used more broadly. ⟦{決|き}まり{文句|もんく}→決まり文句：21431_kimarimonku⟧ means "set phrase" or "cliché" and can carry a slightly negative nuance of being overused or hollow.
